articles.summary: Following the unfortunate death of a student, IIT-Bombay has placed its administrative dean on leave pending an investigation. The institution has retracted its previous statement about the circumstances surrounding the student's examination.

articles.summary: On September 20, Surendra Singh Choudhary, affectionately called Bittu Tabahi, spearheaded a remarkable cleanup initiative along the banks of the Yamuna river. In a dedicated four-hour effort, he and a team of volunteers successfully gathered an impressive 585 kilograms of litter.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Prabhas’ ‘Fauzi’ release postponed, makers promise a ‘Baahubali’-scale film
articles.summary: The anticipated release of Prabhas's war-action spectacle, 'Fauzi,' has been delayed by the film's creators. While no new release date has been confirmed, the film is now projected for arrival in 2027.

articles.title: R Madhavan REACTS to son Vedaant's Asian Games performance
articles.summary: Vedaant Madhavan debuted at the Asian Games in the freestyle relay event. The Indian team did not qualify for the final round.

articles.title: Channing Tatum clarifies that he does not have a secret social media account
articles.summary: In a bold statement on his official Instagram, Channing Tatum has refuted claims about a clandestine social media account, dismissing them as ridiculous. These rumors gained traction after a mysterious profile made derogatory comments about Zoë Kravitz and Harry Styles.

articles.title: Shah Rukh Khan, Gauri get protective of Suhana after vermilion spreads on her face
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan and his family had a heartfelt visit to Lalbaugcha Raja last night, where they participated in the evening aarti and offered their prayers during Ganesh darshan. In a sweet moment, Gauri Khan tenderly wiped the vermilion from Suhana Khan's face with her dupatta, while Shah Rukh Khan attended to his daughter and cleaned his own face too.
